# IdGenerator { #timetoalign.IdGenerator }

```python
IdGenerator(scope, _counters=dict(), _seen=set())
```

Generates unique IDs within a given scope.

Supports both:
1. Wrapping external IDs with the scope
2. Generating new IDs when none provided

Tracks seen IDs to detect collisions.

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name   | Type         | Description                                     |
|--------|--------------|-------------------------------------------------|
| scope  | [str](`str`) | The scope to apply to all generated/wrapped IDs |

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> gen = IdGenerator("midi")
```

```python
>>> gen.get_or_create("n42")  # Wrap external ID
'midi:n42'
```

```python
>>> gen.get_or_create(None, type_hint="note")  # Generate
'midi:note_1'
```

```python
>>> gen.get_or_create(None, type_hint="note")  # Generate next
'midi:note_2'
```

## Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [create](#timetoalign.IdGenerator.create) | Generate a new unique ID (no external ID). |
| [get_or_create](#timetoalign.IdGenerator.get_or_create) | Get a scoped ID string. |
| [has_seen](#timetoalign.IdGenerator.has_seen) | Check if an ID has been generated/wrapped by this generator. |
| [reset](#timetoalign.IdGenerator.reset) | Reset all counters and seen IDs. |
| [reset_counters](#timetoalign.IdGenerator.reset_counters) | Reset counters but keep seen IDs (for continuation). |
| [wrap](#timetoalign.IdGenerator.wrap) | Wrap an external ID with the scope. |

### create { #timetoalign.IdGenerator.create }

```python
IdGenerator.create(type_hint='event')
```

Generate a new unique ID (no external ID).

### get_or_create { #timetoalign.IdGenerator.get_or_create }

```python
IdGenerator.get_or_create(external_id=None, type_hint='event')
```

Get a scoped ID string.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name        | Type                 | Description                                                                                     | Default   |
|-------------|----------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| external_id | [str](`str`) \| None | The ID from the source, if any. Will be wrapped         with the scope but otherwise preserved. | `None`    |
| type_hint   | [str](`str`)         | A prefix for generated IDs if external_id is None.                                              | `'event'` |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type         | Description                                                |
|--------|--------------|------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [str](`str`) | A string in "scope:local_id" format (or just "local_id" if |
|        | [str](`str`) | scope is empty).                                           |

### has_seen { #timetoalign.IdGenerator.has_seen }

```python
IdGenerator.has_seen(id_str)
```

Check if an ID has been generated/wrapped by this generator.

### reset { #timetoalign.IdGenerator.reset }

```python
IdGenerator.reset()
```

Reset all counters and seen IDs.

### reset_counters { #timetoalign.IdGenerator.reset_counters }

```python
IdGenerator.reset_counters()
```

Reset counters but keep seen IDs (for continuation).

### wrap { #timetoalign.IdGenerator.wrap }

```python
IdGenerator.wrap(external_id)
```

Wrap an external ID with the scope.
